The '''Shadow EVO troopers''' were a specialized variant of the [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|shadow]] and [[EVO trooper|EVO troopers]]. They were equipped with [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking devices]] and used [[FA-3 flechette launcher]]s. They were called to the battlefield by [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|stormtrooper commanders]].

==Overview==
These [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] wore an experimental armor developed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] which mixed elements of advanced survival gear as well as the ability to absorb energy discharges with that of a personal [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]]. This made them extremely rare, though they were often sent on operations on alien worlds which involved menacing the local inhabitants and assassinating resistance leaders.<ref name="TFU" />

Similar to the shadow troopers, they were often called into battle by [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|stormtrooper commanders]] where they used their cloaking devices to ambush their enemies where they opened a barrage of fire from their deadly [[FA-3 flechette launcher]]s.<ref name="TFU" />

==History==
The only known usages of shadow EVO troopers were in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], when several were posted with the Imperial garrison at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]<ref name="TFUultimate" /> and at [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime's]] [[Imperial Ore Facility|ore collection facility]]. On Raxus Prime, they assisted the [[EVO trooper]]s.<ref name="TFU" />

[[Galen Marek]] encountered them as they were guarding the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] when he infiltrated it for his [[Starkiller's Trial of the Spirit|Trial of the Spirit]]<ref name="TFUultimate" /> and during his [[Second mission to Raxus Prime]].<ref name="TFU" />
